description: Give the calling assistant an answer to the business’s pending question. Use when get_call_result returns input_required; reply within 45 seconds or the assistant says the person will follow up. Requires direct:tasks and ownership of the call. Never include payment card numbers, passwords or one-time codes. Returns the call state; read get_call_result for the outcome.

answer.description: The answer to the pending question, without card numbers, passwords or one-time codes.

name: answer_call_question
title: Answer a question during your business call
